subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 Mastery Challenge MCQs 1. In the number 482, which digit is in the tens place? A) 4 B) 8 C) 2 D) None of the above 2. Which of the following numbers is the greatest? A) 321 B) 312 C) 231 D) 213 3. The ordinal number for 15 is: A) Fifteenth B) Fifth C) Fiveteen D) Fifty 4. Which of the following Roman numerals represents the number 9? A) VII B) IX C) XI D) IV 5. The word representation of 87 is: A) Eighty-seven B) Eight-seven C) Eighty D) Eight 28
